independent_readonly_review.review_method: Separate LP checks strict feasibility with a global positive slack, then closure extrema and fixed-endpoint attainability; compared to ordering propagation and open/closed endpoint results.

checks: Exact degenerate three-operator formula records reproduce old panel and clock numeric output
All feasible values compatible versus possible overlap versus disjoint, with unknown model/measurement separate
Joint order tightening, infeasible declared normal protocol, explicit post-end projectile impact and nonstrict equality cycle
Strict open endpoints without epsilon, rational 1/3 endpoint overlap and raw first/last/list evidence preservation
Caller-declared 60-FPS coverage independent of model 30 Hz, uncertain deployment origin and partial/multicharge basis
Malformed/nonfinite/reversed bounds, strict identity/context/provenance/clock/protocol failures and output isolation
Actual offscreen Qt editing, read-only references, explicit import/binding, uncertainty state rendering, stale-result invalidation and escaping
